top_comments.author: yurukusa
top_comments.body:
There seem to be two separate issues here:
**1. The 529 Overloaded errors**
These are server-side — when Anthropic's API is under heavy load, it returns 529. A few things that might help reduce the impact:
- **Wait and retry**: 529s are usually transient. Waiting 30-60 seconds and retrying often works. Claude Code has built-in retry logic, but during sustained load it can exhaust its retry budget.
- **Avoid peak hours**: In my experience, load tends to spike during US business hours (roughly 9am

top_comments.body:
Still happening tonight (2026-04-07, ~22:30 PT / 01:30 UTC). Max plan, CLI v2.1.92, Windows 11. Agent had been cogitating for 3m 39s when the 529 hit. Retried 9/10 attempts before surfacing the error.

Request IDs: `req_011CZqpet34VeFtBpuU2mjL4`, `req_011CZqqm6g7Bb7W96ZGa1ans`

This is on top of 7 Desktop renderer crashes today on the same machine. The combination of API overloads + Desktop instability makes the platform effectively unusable for evening work sessions. $200/month Max plan.
